I am an old woman of seventy years, and my strength is not what it was. This small maize plot near the house is where I grow food for myself, so I must care for it well but with little money. I will put some manure from my animals because that costs nothing, and I will use the local seed I saved from last harvest since improved seed is expensive and hard to find here. I cannot afford much fertilizer, but maybe a small bit of DAP from the cooperative if it comes in time. My grandchildren will help me weed because I cannot bend for long.
